title: Capture screen: take or pick a receipt photo with preview
userStory: As a Structly user I want to take a photo or pick one from my library on the Capture screen and see a preview, so I can start turning receipts into a spreadsheet.
acceptanceCriteria: Capture screen shows 'Take photo' and 'Pick from library' actions
Choosing an image shows a preview with a 'Use this receipt' confirm and a retake/change option
Image capture is behind an injectable, testable module in src/lib/ (like src/lib/supabaseAuth.js) covered by scripts/verify-acceptance.js
No Google/OAuth dependency is added (MVP constraint)
